label: Check that no existing row breaks the new state constraints

precheck.description: no automation run has an outcome outside matched, skipped and failed
precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."automation_run" WHERE "outcome" NOT IN ('matched', 'skipped', 'failed')) AS "result"

precheck.description: no bug has needsInfoSince or statusBeforeNeedsInfo outside needs_info, or misses them inside it
precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."bug_report" WHERE ("status" = 'needs_info') <> ("needsInfoSince" IS NOT NULL) OR ("status" = 'needs_info') <> ("statusBeforeNeedsInfo" IS NOT NULL)) AS "result"

precheck.description: no bug saved a status before needs_info that cannot ask the client
precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."bug_report" WHERE "statusBeforeNeedsInfo" IS NOT NULL AND "statusBeforeNeedsInfo" NOT IN ('triaged', 'in_progress', 'in_verification')) AS "result"

precheck.description: no bug has awaitingClientSince that disagrees with awaiting_client
precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."bug_report" WHERE ("status" = 'awaiting_client') <> ("awaitingClientSince" IS NOT NULL)) AS "result"

precheck.description: no bug that is not closed has a resolution
precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."bug_report" WHERE "resolution" IS NOT NULL AND "status" <> 'closed') AS "result"

precheck.description: no job is both completed and dead
precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."job" WHERE "completedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "deadAt" IS NOT NULL) AS "result"

precheck.description: no task has a status that disagrees with completedAt
precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."task" WHERE ("status" = 'done') <> ("completedAt" IS NOT NULL)) AS "result"

precheck.description: no webhook delivery has an unknown status
precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."webhook_delivery" WHERE "status" NOT IN ('pending', 'retrying', 'succeeded', 'dead')) AS "result"

execute.description: nothing to change before the constraints

precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_constraint" AS "c" INNER JOIN "pg_namespace" AS "n" ON "n"."oid" = "c"."connamespace" WHERE ("c"."conname" = $1 AND "n"."nspname" = $2 AND "c"."conrelid" = to_regclass($3))) AS "result"
